### God Remembered Noah
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-remembered-noah
Passage: Genesis 8:1
Points:
- During long seasons of distress, believers can easily feel forgotten by the Lord.
- In Scripture, God "remembering" does not mean recalling forgotten information, but taking action to fulfill His covenant promises.
- God's remembrance of Noah after months in the ark marked the turning point when the waters receded.
- Apparent delays do not mean God is slow; He always acts at the perfect moment.
- The resurrection of Jesus assures believers that God faithfully keeps all His promises.

### Remembering the God Who Remembers You
Author: Jared C. Wilson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/remembering-the-god-who-remembers-you/
Passage: Genesis 8:1
Points:
- In times of storm and isolation, God draws near and actively remembers His people.
- Noah responded to God's care by trusting God's precise timing through long periods of waiting.
- Believers honor God by surrendering compromises and putting His priorities first.
- God preserved Noah to demonstrate that His ultimate aim for creation is restoration rather than ruin.
- The cross of Christ gives permanent proof that God never abandons those He loves.
